title: JavaScript If Else: Choose a Message Based on a Score
description:
Use JavaScript if and else to display a different message depending on a practice score. See how a condition chooses which branch runs.

Try answering: What message would you show when a score is below your target?

Continue learning: open the JavaScript for Beginners playlist on @Techat60.
Subscribe to TECH AT 60 for practical beginner coding lessons.

The if branch runs when its condition is truthy.
The else branch handles the alternative when that condition is false.

Try it: Display a different message depending on a practice score.
